# Crew API: responses (Public endpoints)

Part of the [Crew API reference](README.md).

## POST /v1/responses

Run a turn.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Available now: owner only |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | preview |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with a credential that holds the scope `responses:write`. |

Not served yet:

- Request body fields: `background`, `conversation`, `input[].content[].type=input_file`, `input[].content[].type=input_image`, `input[].type=function_call_output`, `input[].type=mcp_approval_response`, `previous_response_id`, `reasoning.summary`, `text.format.type=json_schema`, `tool_choice=none`, `tools`.
- Request headers: `Idempotency-Key`.
- Response headers: `X-Crew-Quota-Limit`, `X-Crew-Quota-Remaining`, `X-Crew-Quota-Reset`.

stream=true returns text/event-stream; background=true returns queued at once. Delegated credential: model must be the template id of the app's capability bundle, \<client_id>/\<bundle.agent.id>, or a Bot the grant allows, and conversation must be one opened under this grant. Spends credits against the grant quota; a retry with the same Idempotency-Key is not charged again. Phase 1 accepts text only; `input_image`, `input_file`, `text.format: json_schema` and `reasoning.summary` are phase 2 and open per agent as capabilities reports; when the agent does not support one, 422 capability_unavailable. When json_schema validation fails the whole turn is failed with error.code structured_output_invalid. In the preview, a turn that fair admission refuses answers 200 with status failed and the capacity message.

Request headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | no | The minor version the client was written for. Without it, the server answers with 1.0 behaviour. The server never refuses a request because this version is old. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string | no | A caller may supply its own; an id assigned by an intermediary in front of the gateway wins. |
| `Idempotency-Key` | string | no | **Not served yet.** Accepted by every Public POST. Within one grant, a retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first result (the same object id) and is neither run again nor charged again; the same key with a different body is 422 idempotency_key_reused. |

## GET /v1/responses/{response_id}

Read a turn; can resume its stream.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Planned |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | stable |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with a credential that holds the scope `conversations:read` or `responses:write`. |

Holding either conversations:read or responses:write is enough; with only responses:write, only responses this grant created can be read. Stream events are stored with the response, so the stream can be resumed. Retention: stored responses (with the stream events used to resume), the event index, resolved approvals and uploaded files are all kept 30 days by default; the owner can set `crew_api.retention_days` in the crew settings to 1 to 365 days. Deleting a conversation deletes its responses and events. After the retention period this returns 404 not_found.

Path parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `response_id` | string | yes | resp_ id |

Query parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stream` | boolean | no | true resumes the stream as SSE. |
| `starting_after` | integer | no | Resume after the Nth stream event (sequence_number). |

Request headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | no | The minor version the client was written for. Without it, the server answers with 1.0 behaviour. The server never refuses a request because this version is old. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string | no | A caller may supply its own; an id assigned by an intermediary in front of the gateway wins. |

Response `200`: Success.

## POST /v1/responses/{response_id}/cancel

Cancel a running turn.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Planned |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | stable |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with a credential that holds the scope `responses:write`. |
